query: For my 56-year-old female patient, what's the longest inpatient prescription duration (days) for hydralazine or isosorbide dinitrate in women 51–61?
final_sql: SELECT MAX(p.stoptime - p.starttime) AS max_duration FROM physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.prescriptions p JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients pt ON p.subject_id = pt.subject_id JOIN physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions a ON p.hadm_id = a.hadm_id WHERE pt.gender = 'F' AND pt.anchor_age = 56 AND pt.anchor_year_group BETWEEN 51 AND 61 AND (p.drug = 'hydralazine' OR p.drug = 'isosorbide dinitrate');
